name: azito-agent-base
description: Browser-based tmux session manager for Claude Code / Codex agents

scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/server
scripts.e2e: npm run build:web && npm run build --workspace=packages/tui-supervisor && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
